newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT FINISHES EASIER VS DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT FINISHES EASIER VS DOLLAR.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed afternoon trading slightly wekaer against the dollar on Monday as the U.S. currency firmed against the mark, dealers said.
"The forint eased as the dollar was higher against the mark," said Citibank's Peter Benda.
The forint finished at 171.15/25, compared with 170.10/13 at midday.

The gap below the central bank's resistance level (bid) narrgwed to some two pips from 10 to 15 pips in the morning, on a lacklustre forint market which could not follow the hecticly moving dollar/mark, dealers said.
Easing dollar and Swiss franc maturities were in focus of futures trading in the morning on the Budapest Commodity Exchange.
The dollar dropped 15 to 40 fillers for all maturities, while the Swiss franc firmed 20 to 50 fillers for Narch, September and December.
